sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:116

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:116:1
items.html: The Hochma and Bina of ZA are drops drawn from the two upper joints of Hesed and Gevura of AA, and they are an illumination and not their very selves, etc., but the Daat, etc., is from the two lower joints of Hesed and Gevura of AA — they are their very selves and not their illumination. As is explained in the adjacent item; see there. However, that which he writes, that HB are the two upper joints of HG, the intention is to the two upper joints of each one of them: for the two joints of Hesed became the Hochma of Aba and his Bina; and likewise the two upper joints of Gevura became the Hochma of Ima and her Bina. And both of them are the discernment of the Roshim of AVI, and from there the inheritance [Achsanta] is drawn. And that which he writes, the two lower joints of HG that became the Daat, the intention is to one joint alone, namely the lower joint of the Hesed and the lower joint of the Gevura. For they remained in HGT and did not rise to the Roshim of AVI, as above; and therefore ZA takes their actual self, for they are his own discernment, since ZA is always the discernment of HGT, as is known.
